verdict.rationale: Shopify's docs say it ships 'officially supported libraries' for building apps in common languages and frameworks. It also offers Hydrogen as an official headless storefront framework and the Shopify CLI for scaffolding. Libraries are versioned on the quarterly API release schedule, and the AI Toolkit connects AI coding tools to official docs and schemas. A community complaint about API design is general criticism, not a concrete contradiction of the SDKs, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: named SDK languages and package details, depth of per-SDK documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
